summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a new shareholders' agreement between Petrobras and FIP, which governs joint control of the company post-transaction involving Novonor. The agreement requires consensus on board and shareholder resolutions, with equal board representation. It becomes effective at closing, subject to judicial approvals, and has a 30-year term with termination provisions if combined stake falls below 50% or if FIP transfers >=5% of shares. This filing reports a structural control change rather than a routine event, but the primary event is the formation of a new controlling shareholder group, making this akin to a management/governance change. This is a non-US filing (Brazil) mapped to a Form 8-K Item 5.02 departure/disclosure equivalent.
